metadata.name: context-map-materializer
metadata.description: Run the Distiller -> Cartographer -> Evictor pipeline for a corpus_key. Fetches unprocessed events, calls two LLM passes, and atomically updates the context map.

max_event_tokens.description: Approximate token budget for event input to the Distiller.

token_budget.description: Maximum token budget for the context map.

parent_skeleton:
# Skill: context-map-materializer

Runs the full Distiller -> Cartographer -> Evictor pipeline for one corpus.
Safe to run multiple times; idempotent already-processed events are skipped.

materialize_context_map.name: materialize_context_map
materialize_context_map.description: Runs the full Distiller -> Cartographer -> Evictor pipeline for one corpus. Safe to run multiple times; idempotent already-processed events are skipped.

max_event_tokens.description: Approximate token budget for event input to the Distiller. Default 8000.

token_budget.description: Maximum token budget for the context map. Default 1024.

side_effects: writes context map to internal storage
preconditions: corpus_key refers to an existing corpus
postconditions: context map is updated and available for retrieval

error_conditions.recovery_hint: Verify the corpus key and retry
Adjust token budget parameters and retry
